claim: The project contains eight canonical branch evidence nodes whose historical scientific closure states are preserved and independently integrity-checked before integration.

The final frozen dependency atlas contains 16 project-level bridges: 8 PARTIAL_STRUCTURAL, 3 IDENTITY_ONLY, 3 BLOCKED_PUBLIC_ASSET and 2 BLOCKED_SCHEMA; no DIRECT_NUMERIC cross-branch bridge was established.

A coherent methodological chain can be described structurally from public strain/DQ/calibration through detection/catalog, event-level PE and population inference toward downstream products including standard-siren cosmology, but the project does not measure a single end-to-end numerical transfer.
All eight PARTIAL_STRUCTURAL edges retain UNRESOLVED_ATTRIBUTION; structural upstream/downstream placement does not identify a unique causal source of downstream differences.
The B03 selection/injection NO-GO identifies a public-asset reproducibility boundary and remains visible as a blocked evidence node.
The B04 remnant/ringdown HOLD identifies a public-schema reproducibility boundary and remains visible as a blocked evidence node.
B07 constrains independent-release transport/reproducibility to identity-level statements because no compatible replication test was executed.
B08 contributes a bounded public-output-dependence result for standard-siren H0 products, while preserving the partial-primary 10/12 state and its own true-H0/causal-bias claim boundary.
The strongest project-wide result is a reproducible dependency/provenance atlas with explicit breakpoints and reopen conditions, rather than a new claim about black-hole fundamental physics.
Blocked, partial and identity-only edges are positive information about what current public releases permit or prevent researchers from testing reproducibly.
